prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE PHILADELPHIA EAGLES game-cover atlas, EXACTLY THREE EQUAL WIDE LANDSCAPE 16:10 panels stacked vertically (one column, three rows; overall portrait ratio 1:1.875). The attached sprite sheet is the ONLY visual style and character identity reference. Use FIRST ROW Eagles: Saquon Barkley #26 runner, Jalen Hurts #1 quarterback, Jake Elliott #4 kicker. CRITICAL STYLE MATCH: the output must look like a screenshot of THESE SAME CHUNKY 3D CARTOON SPRITES performing football plays. Keep their oversized expressive heads, short stocky athletic bodies, broad exaggerated shoulders, chunky hands/boots, stylized clean face sculpting, simplified smooth skin, thick jersey folds, collectible arcade-character materials, silver feather shoulder trim and faithful faces/hair/numbers. Redraw the SAME sprite characters in completely new action poses using AI. DO NOT change into realistic humans, normal human proportions, drawn comic art, painted sports illustration, realistic skin, photography, realistic stadium photo background, or flat vector shapes. ALL supporting players and environments must be in the SAME polished 3D CARTOON videogame style. Nothing should look like a real sports photo. NO photoreal textures or human anatomy proportions.
Camera: elevated oblique SIDEWAYS/ISOMETRIC sideline view, looking down at field at 35 degrees with diagonal yard lines, like a stylized arcade football game. Entire main action fits in central 85% of EACH WIDE panel; main player same anatomical scale as nearby teammates. 6-8 distinct chunky cartoon athletes per scene. Different positions, weight shifts, limbs, contact, no repeated standing sprites. Supporting players helmets and Eagles midnight green/white or Cowboys navy/white uniforms.
TOP PANEL, touchdown run: Barkley #26 cutting sideways, body leaning into turn, football tucked in one arm, stiff arm warding off a Cowboys defender diving toward his hips, a green blocker actively shoving another defender at chest, a green teammate sprinting downfield, other defenders chasing. Golden afternoon on green turf with painted 20 and Eagles end-zone corner; STYLIZED 3D South Philly rowhouses and chunky stadium stands far behind. Natural coherent joints but preserve cartoon proportions.
MIDDLE PANEL, passing drive: Hurts #1 lower left in a planted wide stance, left foot toward receiver, torso twisting, throwing arm high just before release holding the ONE football, front arm balances; green linemen with bent knees physically engaging Cowboys rushers, receiver running a break at far right, corner turning to follow. Cool blue stadium lights, near midfield eagle logo, STYLIZED silver-truss cartoon grandstand. Completely different framing and background from top.
BOTTOM PANEL, field goals: Elliott #4 swings right leg through ball, left foot planted beside a kneeling green holder whose ONE knee is down and hands have just withdrawn; green offensive line pushes back white Cowboys rush, one defender jumps arms extended; ONE ball in air toward yellow upright at upper right. Gray autumn light at a different goal-line corner with green padded cartoon tunnel, chunky crowds and benches, no rowhouses or midfield truss. All body parts connected and correctly balanced as actual play would be, in original sprite proportions.
Use detailed clean polished cartoon rendering and integrated shadows. THREE separate full-bleed wide cover illustrations, not sprite cutouts on photo backdrops. No captions, labels, typography, borders, watermarks, duplicate characters, extra limbs, extra balls or matching poses. Most essential: EXACT ORIGINAL SPRITE ART STYLE, exaggerated head/body proportions and materials. Not a hand-drawn comic or realistic human render.
